column1: # Maritime decision points rated on the Operational Suitability board. Tab-separated.
# site_id      short code; used in anchors and payload keys
# active       1 = rated on the pages, 0 = hidden (kept for history)
# lat lon      DISPLAY position (the place a mariner means)
# zone_lat     offshore "nudge" position used ONLY for the NWS marine-zone lookup.
# zone_lon     Harbour points fall outside every marine polygon and resolve to no
#              zone at all (verified: Cruz Bay and Salinas both do), so each site
#              carries a point that is genuinely in the water. Same as lat/lon when
# exposure     open bearing arc the site is exposed to, e.g. 290-070 (wraps past 360), or -
# zone         NWS marine zone id. VERIFIED LIVE against
# obs_wave     comma list of src_id from sources.tsv, in PRIORITY ORDER. The first
# obs_wind     source with data fresher than its max_age_h wins; the page names
# obs_current  whichever one it used. '-' = none available, fall back to the forecast.
# tide         CO-OPS station id from sources.tsv, or -
# classes      vessel classes rated here: ship,ferry,small,rec
# group        display grouping on the board
# embed        which existing CARICOOS tool this site's drawer frames: buoys
# notes        free text; stale/offline/retired/closed marks the site down
